summary: Baileys fork with char-code-obfuscated exfiltration endpoint in messages-send
details: diezyyasha-baileys is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library. lib/Socket/messages-send.js contains a hardcoded network destination reconstructed at runtime from a String.fromCharCode decimal array (lines 425 and 436). Decoding the byte sequence resolves to the URL https://fiora.nixel.my.id/ — a third-party host unrelated to the upstream Baileys project. Concealing an outbound endpoint via char-code decoding, rather than as a plain string, is the standard obfuscation pattern used to hide exfiltration destinations from casual review of a WhatsApp session library that has direct access to caller message content, session keys, and paired-device credentials.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
